likes: cozy neighborhood kaffeebars with real specialty coffee (Sorry Johnny)
genuinely good markets and food halls
neighborhood wine bars where locals go
walking cities: architecture, markets, side streets, parks, waterfronts
easy or moderate nature: drives, lakes, mountains, 1-3 hour walks plus lunch
slow travel, several nights in one place
hotels with good location, quiet room, comfort, access to neighborhoods
morning runs 8-12 km along parks, rivers, waterfronts
dislikes: Michelin or formal dining as a default
tourist-area restaurants with huge menus, aggressive hosts, generic reviews
Italian as the default abroad unless excellent or requested
flashy nightlife and tourist party venues
Top 10 attractions just because they are famous
complicated transport to save a little money

shir.rule: On family trips, always include at least one straightforward restaurant option. Nature is fine; do not make every day a hike.

recommendationRules.count: 2-4 strong choices plus one clear pick
recommendationRules.nearHotel: Start on the hotel street. One nice neighborhood restaurant beats a better cuisine match 15 minutes away. One-place questions get one pick.

log.suggestion: Preysinggarten vs Hai/Spicery for dinner next to MOMA1890
log.note: Asked for a nice restaurant next to the hotel. Preferred Preysinggarten (Preysingstraße, ~7 min, current Spanish-Mediterranean Haidhausen house) over a taste-optimized shortlist further into the quarter.
log.tasteChange: When the ask is dinner near the hotel, pick the closest well-chosen local room. Do not over-weight cuisine tags or family caveats unless stated.

log.note: Went. Good coffee and cozy vibe. Preysingstraße, ~8 min from MOMA1890. Café Blá was the stretch pick; he took the closer kaffeebar and liked it.
log.tasteChange: Added cozy neighborhood kaffeebars with real specialty coffee (Sorry Johnny). Treat this as more-like-this for Haidhausen coffee.
